newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners net sellers of Japanese stocks in week.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners net sellers of Japanese stocks in week.

text.p: Foreigners were net sellers of Japanese stocks on the Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya stock exchanges in the week of October 14 to 18, exchange data issued on Thursday showed.
Foreigners have been net sellers for the past two weeks after buying continuously for the five weeks prior to that, according to the data.
The figures, which are rounded, are as follows:
Previous week net selling 513.71 million yen
